responsibility: Provides IR-independent low-level control-flow graph management for functions. It owns CFG initialization and teardown (`init_flow`, `free_cfg`), allocation and chaining of basic blocks, generic edge creation/removal and redirection plumbing, block compaction and expunging, auxiliary storage management, profile/count rescaling helpers, and bookkeeping tables that map duplicated blocks or loops back to originals and copies; RTL- and GIMPLE-specific files layer representation-aware behavior on top of this generic CFG substrate.
same_name_distinction: Implements the generic, IR-independent CFG machinery itself—allocation, linking, edge updates, block compaction, profile scaling, and original/copy tables—whereas gcc/cfg.h is the declaration and data-structure header that exposes that API and defines the control_flow_graph container and RAII flag helpers.
